skills.name: CTF methodology
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Read the description twice; list given artifacts (file.list).
2. Classify the challenge type (web/crypto/pwn/forensics/reversing).
3. Pick the matching playbook.
4. Time-box attempts; switch when stuck.
5. Write up the solution.

skills.name: CTF web recon
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Fetch the app (web.browser).
2. Enumerate endpoints (web.dirbrute small).
3. Read JS for hidden hints (process.exec curl + python.run_file).
4. Note tech stack from headers (web.headervuln).
5. Plan attacks.

skills.name: Flag format discipline
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Confirm the flag format from the rules.
2. Search artifacts for the pattern (python.run_file).
3. Verify against the platform before submitting.
4. Track attempts.
5. Record the solve.

skills.name: Crypto challenge basics
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Identify the cipher from ciphertext properties (python.run_file analysis).
2. Try known attacks for the family (frequency, XOR reuse).
3. Use python.run_file implementations.
4. Verify plaintext sanity.
5. Document the path.

skills.name: Encoding chain solving
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Detect layer (base64/hex/gzip) via magic/charset (python.run_file).
2. Peel layers iteratively.
3. Stop when flag format appears.
4. Record the chain.
5. Save artifacts.

skills.name: File forensics basics
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Identify type/metadata (re.hex.identify).
2. carve embedded payloads (python.run_file).
3. Check stego basics if image (comments/LSB quick check).
4. Verify findings.
5. Document.

skills.name: PCAP challenges
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Load the pcap (python.run_file scapy if available).
2. Follow streams; extract payloads (python.run_file).
3. Filter by protocol/port.
4. Hunt flag patterns.
5. Record evidence.

skills.name: Reversing static basics
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. re.hex.identify the binary.
2. re.r2.analyze / re.ghidra.analyze for logic.
3. Identify the check; extract the condition.
4. Solve constraints with python.run_file (e.g., z3-style manual).
5. Verify the flag.

skills.name: Reversing dynamic basics
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Run in your lab (process.exec).
2. Trace syscalls/strings (process.exec strace/strings).
3. Patch trivial checks (re.ghidra.analyze-guided, local binary patch).
4. Capture the revealed secret.
5. Document.

skills.name: Pwning basics (lab)
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Check protections (process.exec checksec-like).
2. re.ghidra.analyze for the vulnerable function.
3. Craft overflow input with pattern (python.run_file).
4. Find offset; control PC (lab only).
5. Escalate to shell locally.

skills.name: ROP chain notes
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. List gadgets (process.exec ROPgadget if available).
2. Plan the chain for the goal (execve).
3. Assemble with python.run_file (struct packing).
4. Test locally with ASLR off first.
5. Document.

skills.name: SSTI in CTFs
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Confirm SSTI with math probes (http.replay).
2. Fingerprint engine (error-driven).
3. Use engine-specific payloads (python.run_file list).
4. Read the flag via allowed primitives.
5. Write-up.

skills.name: SQLi in CTFs
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Detect injection point (http.replay errors).
2. Pick technique per DB (web.sqlmap or manual).
3. Extract the flag table (limited dumps).
4. Verify the flag.
5. Document payload chain.

skills.name: JWT challenges
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Decode the token (python.run_file).
2. Test alg pitfalls (none/HS-RS confusion) on the challenge.
3. Forge with the recovered secret.
4. Access the protected flag endpoint.
5. Record.

skills.name: Steganography quick wins
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Check metadata/comments (re.hex.identify).
2. Run LSB/LSB-plane quick views (python.run_file PIL).
3. Test common passphrases with steghide-like tools if available (process.exec).
4. Escalate to deeper tools only if promising.
5. Record.

skills.name: CTF write-up style
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Structure: challenge, path, solution, artifacts (file.write).
2. Include key commands and snippets.
3. Redact flags if the event requires.
4. Publish per event rules.
5. Archive.

skills.name: Team CTF coordination
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Shared notes file per challenge (file.write).
2. Record owners and status.
3. Hand off with context.
4. Time-box stuck challenges.
5. Post-event review.

skills.name: CTF practice plan
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Pick a platform (web.search).
2. Schedule per-category practice.
3. Review write-ups after attempts.
4. Track solved categories (file.write).
5. Adjust focus.

skills.name: Disclosure policy navigation
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Read the vendor policy (web.crawl).
2. Use the official channel.
3. Provide repro steps + impact.
4. Honor embargo.
5. Record communications.

skills.name: Bounty report style
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Clear title with type+location.
2. Steps to reproduce from scratch.
3. Impact with realistic scenario.
4. Supporting evidence (redacted).
5. Suggested fix.

skills.name: Remediation advice library
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Maintain per-vuln-class fix snippets (file.write).
2. Cite standards (OWASP) via web.search.
3. Tailor to the stack.
4. Include test suggestions.
5. Keep versioned.

skills.name: Executive summaries
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. One-paragraph risk statement.
2. Business impact in plain language.
3. Top 3 actions with owners.
4. No jargon in the summary.
5. Detail in appendix.

skills.name: Findings prioritizer
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Score by (severity x exposure x exploitability) (python.run_file).
2. Group by system owner.
3. Propose sprint-sized batches.
4. Track completion.
5. Report.

skills.name: Vulnerability trend analysis
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Load history (file.read).
2. Compute trends (python.run_file).
3. Identify systemic causes.
4. Propose structural fixes.
5. Report.

skills.name: Security champion enablement
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Prepare per-team checklists (file.write).
2. Host short walkthroughs (chat/scripts).
3. Provide tool recipes.
4. Track adoption.
5. Summarize.

skills.name: Red team report style
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Structure: scope, methodology, findings, chain narrative.
2. Attach evidence per finding.
3. Include detection gaps.
4. Redact sensitive data.
5. Deliver with debrief notes.

skills.name: Blue feedback loop
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Map each finding to a control gap.
2. Propose detections (cat_res_detection_guidance).
3. Validate alerts in lab.
4. Track closure.
5. Summarize.

skills.name: Threat modeling basics
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Diagram data flows in text (file.write).
2. Apply STRIDE per element.
3. List mitigations per threat.
4. Prioritize by risk.
5. Review with the team.

skills.name: Secure review gate
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Define gate checklist (file.write).
2. Run static scans (python.run_file patterns).
3. Review authz changes manually.
4. Block on high findings.
5. Record decisions.

skills.name: Incident timeline building
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Collect logs across sources (process.exec/logcat).
2. Normalize timestamps (python.run_file).
3. Order events; mark confidence.
4. Identify root cause candidates.
5. Report.

skills.name: Containment playbook
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Isolate affected systems (user-approved actions).
2. Revoke exposed credentials (checklist).
3. Preserve evidence read-only.
4. Communicate status.
5. Document everything.

skills.name: Eradication planning
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Inventory persistence mechanisms (root.exec reviews).
2. Remove each with verification.
3. Rotate all credentials.
4. Validate with scans.
5. Record.

skills.name: Lessons learned doc
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Timeline recap (file.write).
2. What worked/what failed.
3. Action items with owners/dates.
4. Feed into playbooks.
5. Review completion.

skills.name: Tabletop exercises
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Draft a scenario (file.write).
2. Walk roles through decisions.
3. Record gaps.
4. Update playbooks.
5. Summarize outcomes.

skills.name: Risk register upkeep
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Record risks with owner/likelihood/impact (file.write).
2. Review monthly.
3. Update mitigations.
4. Escalate changes.
5. Summarize top risks.

skills.name: Policy template pack
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Templates: acceptable use, access control, incident response (file.write).
2. Tailor to the org.
3. Review cycle annually.
4. Track versions.
5. Summarize.

skills.name: Security awareness content
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Short modules per topic (file.write).
2. Real examples from your findings (redacted).
3. Quiz questions.
4. Track completion (team).
5. Refresh quarterly.

skills.name: Vendor risk assessment
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Collect security posture signals (web.search).
2. Review data access needs.
3. Score risk (python.run_file rubric).
4. Recommend contract terms.
5. Record.

skills.name: Asset inventory management
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Merge sources: cloud, LAN scan, DNS (python.run_file).
2. Flag unknowns.
3. Assign owners.
4. Review monthly.
5. Summarize coverage.

skills.name: Patch management loop
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Track advisories for your stack (cat_res_cve_monitoring_setup).
2. Schedule windows.
3. Verify post-patch (cat_web_vuln_retest flow).
4. Report compliance.
5. Adjust cadence.

skills.name: Hardening baselines
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. CIS-inspired baselines per platform (file.write).
2. Audit against them (python.run_file checks).
3. Fix drift.
4. Version baselines.
5. Summarize.
